definitions.explanation: A young dog, typically less than one year old.

examples.japanese: {子犬|こいぬ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっぽ→しっぽ：09089_shippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}っている→振る：01983_furu⟧。
examples.english: The puppy is wagging its tail.
Puppies were born at the neighbor's house, so I went to see them.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペット→ペット：02959_petto⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧{子犬|こいぬ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かわいくて→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧、つい⟦{飼|か}いたく→飼う：08151_kau⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The puppy I saw at the pet shop was so cute that I couldn't help wanting to keep it.

notes:
{子犬|こいぬ} refers to a young dog, typically under one year old. It is formed from ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child, young) + ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧ (dog), following a productive pattern used for other young animals: {子猫|こねこ} (kitten), ⟦{子馬|こうま}→子馬：19287_kouma⟧ (foal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子犬|こいぬ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep/raise a puppy
- {子犬|こいぬ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to find/pick up a stray puppy
- {子犬|こいぬ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: puppies are born

COUNTER: ⟦{匹|ひき}→匹：00939_hiki⟧ (for small animals).
